about: Which content passes each course has had. Update it whenever a pass changes a course, and regenerate docs/library.md with `node scripts/library-report.mjs`.

passes.summary: 13 of the 18 October courses rewritten to the v2 lesson format (with 4b711fb, 1fdb475)
Story lessons for every course then in the library (20): opener, teaching screens, practice, three-question check, recap
45 courses written from researched curricula in docs/curricula/, already in the story format
Openers end on the subject (41 courses)
Choice options reordered so the right one is not usually first (all courses)
Screens no longer refer to a figure they do not have (38 courses)
Short topic titles on every teaching screen (all courses)
Code set as code in the 28 software courses
Teaching screens trimmed to what their idea needs, 19% less to read (all courses)
Every lesson read as a learner: 1,406 corrections (all 65 courses)
Every question judged against what its format is for (all courses)
Answers marked as their prompts ask; the November review's listed errors corrected (48 courses)
Every source address requested and recorded; 16 corrected (all courses); 18 courses then cite the section behind each lesson
Writing tasks for the five writing courses; code exercises in Python, SQL and the first five TypeScript lessons
Full question rewrite of 36 courses: material in front of the learner, judgement questions, order and sort, quoted sources, misconception distractors
How the Body Works and The Roman Republic written from fetched source packs
Targeted pass on the other 30 courses: option lengths, feedback for every wrong option, two hints; fuller pass on the three writing courses
Blind review of 24 random questions in each of the 30 targeted-pass courses, with four fully rewritten courses as controls: 25 courses at the controls' level, 5 below it
The 25 single questions the review judged shallow or flawed in the other courses, rewritten one by one (19 courses)
Full question rewrite of Earth and Environmental Science, Biology, Creative and Game Writing, Writing Longer Pieces and Materials and Manufacturing, the five courses below the bar

Judgement, not arithmetic: in 45 conceptual and mixed courses, the 721 calculation questions that were arithmetic in the subject's setting or an idea behind an exact sum became multiple-choice judgements on the same scenarios (which costs more, roughly how much, which way it moves). Where computing is the skill, calculation stays. How Government Works written from a fetched source pack: 13 lessons, 120 questions, no numeric question, 56 quoted extracts checked word for word against the pack, and no run of eight copied words outside them

Question-quality sweep, first nine courses: every lesson question reviewed for giveaways, off-subject work, debatable keys and trivia; 79 revised in place. Courses: history, roman-republic, english-reading-writing-and-rhetoric, drawing-and-visual-art-fundamentals, creative-and-game-writing, technical-writing, earth-and-environmental-science, industrial-and-product-design, small-buildings-and-architectural-design

Modern Physics written from a fetched source pack: 14 lessons, 145 questions (45 numeric, each recomputed from the constants in its content test), 6 quoted extracts checked word for word against the pack, and no run of eight copied words outside them

Thermodynamics and Energy Systems written from a fetched source pack: 14 lessons, 154 questions (48 numeric, each recomputed from the question's figures and the pack's tables in its content test), 7 quoted extracts checked word for word against the pack, and no run of eight copied words outside them

Question-quality sweep, next twelve courses, aimed at end checks and steps that repeat a case the lesson has already worked: 144 questions revised in place, each repeated case given new figures with the same skill. Courses: calculus-series-and-differential-equations, cs-basics, electronics-foundations, engineering-structures-and-machines, linear-algebra-vectors-and-maps, mechanisms-and-machine-design, mechatronics-and-robotics, physics-motion-and-forces, physics-waves-electricity-heat, sound-and-audio-fundamentals, systems-programming, trigonometry

Personal Finance and Investing written from a fetched source pack under Australian rules: 14 lessons, 133 questions (none numeric: a learner judges which choice costs more and roughly how much, so the 19 first written as numeric became multiple-choice, sort and order judgements, and their figures are recomputed in the content test), 11 quoted extracts checked word for word against the pack, and no run of eight copied words outside them apart from short ATO table labels

Accounting: Reading the Numbers of a Business written from a fetched source pack, on the 2026 annual reports of Woolworths Group and Lovisa: 14 lessons, 142 questions (none numeric: a learner judges what the statements show, and the figures behind every judgement are recomputed in the content test from statement lines copied from the pack), 22 quoted extracts checked word for word against the pack, and no run of eight copied words from Lyryx, the IFRS Foundation or ASIC's focus areas page; the few runs of eight or more words from the two annual reports, ASIC's media release and Wikipedia are attributed sentences

Corporate Finance: How Businesses Decide written from a fetched source pack, with the Woolworths Group and Lovisa 2026 annual reports, the ATO, the RBA, Wikipedia and two open textbooks (paraphrased): 14 lessons, 130 questions (none numeric: a learner judges each decision, and the figures behind every judgement are recomputed in the content test, including the curves four figures draw), 21 quoted extracts checked word for word against the pack, and no run of eight copied words from the UQ or Touro textbooks; the one longer run is a two-sentence Wikipedia quotation attributed in the text

Genetics: From Genes to Genomes written from a fetched source pack: 14 lessons, 147 questions (19 take a typed number, all of them cross ratios, recombination, pedigree chances, Hardy-Weinberg proportions or the odds ratio of a scan; everywhere else a learner judges, so the five numeric questions elsewhere became choices), the figures behind every lesson recomputed in the content test from the NCBI codon table and from figures copied from the pack, 16 quoted extracts checked word for word against the pack, and no run of eight copied words outside them
